segments.t: At Claude Monet, kostya explains why he can't move in with Nastya. Kostya explains to Nastya why he can't move in with her. Let's listen closely to their exchange in Russian first, and then walk through each line together.

'He cannot afford it on his own.' The phrasing opens with 'one' before bringing in 'to pull' to make the point clear.
